summary: Detached bungalow with picturesque rural views in Canonbie, Scottish Borders. Spacious living and dining kitchen, 3 double bedrooms, family bathroom, garage, and boiler room. Front and rear gardens. Close to River Esk, local amenities, and commuter links. Ideal for country living near Carlisle, Gretna, and Langholm.
description:
Situated in the picturesque village of Canonbie, this charming, detached bungalow offers a delightful rural outlook. The spacious living and dining kitchen provide a perfect space for family gatherings, while the three double bedrooms and family bathroom offer ample accommodation. Complete with a garage, boiler room, and gardens to the front and rear, this property ticks all the boxes for comfortable living.

Canonbie boasts excellent local amenities, including shops, a primary school, and scenic river walks along the nearby River Esk. Commuters will appreciate the convenient access to the A7 Carlisle/Edinburgh route and the M6/A74 at junction forty-four, making destinations such as Gretna, Longtown, Carlisle, and Langholm easily reachable.

Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to own a beautiful home in a sought-after location.

Services Oil powered central heating with mains electric, water and drains being connected. Neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking. • The garage is located in a conservation area, the remain parts of the property, are outside the conservation area.
